The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] orbited a '''sun'''. For several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Star/Legends|sun]] did not fully set in Bastion's sky and the sky never grew darker than twilight.<ref name="Revelation" />
